name: ReelShuffle - Saved Reels Feed
description: Revisit your own saved Instagram reels in a private, shuffled feed.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; connect-src 'self' https://www.instagram.com; img-src 'self' data: https://www.instagram.com https://*.cdninstagram.com https://*.fbcdn.net; media-src https://www.instagram.com https://*.cdninstagram.com https://*.fbcdn.net;
